score_matrix.rationale: Mechanical validation passed (applies cleanly, allowlist OK, question schema OK). The OPEN_QUESTIONS.md hunk correctly sets `Status: Solved`, `Resolved by: UBU-D0347`, keeps metadata on one line and rewrites only the Resolution. All five subquestions are directly answered: a malformed-vs-user-controlled completion-test table; `counterparty_autonomy_acknowledgment` as a versioned, user-confirmed record with invariant codes rather than a Boolean; authentic refusal defined by attribution and scoped meaning with terminal closure via the existing §22.3.2 status mappings; one bounded clarification with cross-Task/Device communication accounting that prevents budget resets; and reopening only through a new transition/Objective with a versioned materially-new-evidence basis and stronger review. The DECISIONS.md entry is consistent with the DESIGN.md section and the preceding UBU-D0345/D0346 pattern, and the two cross-reference edits in §22.3.1 and §22.3.2 are minimal hygiene removing UBU-Q0097 from retained-scope lists. It stays documentation-only, adds no new questions, and explicitly bounds remaining scope to existing questions. Points deducted for density and some orchestration-level detail that goes beyond a data-model contract, which raises maintenance and consistency burden rather than correctness concerns.
risks: DESIGN.md §22.3.3 is long and dense; the communication-slot reservation, idempotent transport retry and concurrent-Device dispatch material leans toward orchestration/sync detail for a decision typed as 'Data model', and may overlap with DEVICE_SYNC_AND_COMPARTMENT_CONTRACT.md and UBU-Q0099 pacing scope.

Introduces many new named fields and enumerations (binding fields, `acknowledgment_id`, six invariant codes, `review_status`, `reopening_basis`, communication attempt purposes) without a consolidated field table; future proposals must keep these names consistent across §22.3.1–22.3.3.
Cross-references to UBU-Q0101 and the §22.4 'stronger default advisory safeguards' cannot be verified from this prompt; the author's validation notes claim referenced IDs were checked.

Historical decision text in UBU-D0345/UBU-D0346 still says Step/refusal validation 'retains remaining scope'; acceptable as a historical record but a reader following those decisions must also find §22.3.3.

Allowing a user-attested report to suffice as authentic refusal (under evidence policy) is appropriate for autonomy but shifts attribution risk onto UBU-Q0092 typed evidence policy, which remains open.
